name: pm-codex-bridge
description: Connects Claude to PM Codex running on this computer. Claude reads your project and proposes changes; you approve them in the app.
long_description: Starts the PM Codex bridge on this computer. Claude asks the bridge a question; the bridge asks your open PM Codex tab (http://localhost); the tab answers from its live state. Claude can file a batch of edits as a single change request, which appears in the app with Approve, Review and Reject buttons. Claude cannot change a project record itself - nothing happens until you sign off, and the outcome is reported back to Claude on its next call. Tasks, issues and deliverables can be archived and read back; fields can be checked against the app's own rules before a value is proposed. Made by the Connect to Claude button in Pinokio, for this computer's copy of PM Codex.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Load the master directive and a snapshot of the active project.

tools.name: read_item
tools.description: Read one or many records in full, in a single call.

tools.name: search_project
tools.description: Keyword search across the whole project.

tools.name: read_archive
tools.description: List archived tasks, issues or deliverables. Left out of the snapshot and search on purpose.

tools.name: get_current_screen
tools.description: See which module the user has open.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: Read one module of the project in full, for anything the snapshot held back.

tools.name: get_field_schema
tools.description: The exact field rules for one module - enum values, computed fields, and the live risk matrix - so a proposal cannot fail silently on a misspelled value.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List every project and mark the active one.

tools.name: propose_changes
tools.description: File a batch of edits as one change request for you to approve.

tools.name: discard_change
tools.description: Withdraw one proposed change from a pending request.

tools.name: get_acr_status
tools.description: See what has been proposed, approved and rejected.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Check whether the PM Codex tab is connected.
